summary: CNH Industrial N.V. filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, reporting first-quarter 2026 results. Consolidated revenues were $3.8 billion (flat YoY), net income $10 million ($0.01 EPS), and adjusted net income $21 million. The filing is an ordinary earnings release with no special-situations event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring. It includes a press release and investor presentation under Items 2.02 and 7.01. No deal terms or strategic corporate action are present; the filing is routine and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
